title: ChroDrip - IMAC
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uvvew66
materials: Deionized water Cleaning solution 1: 6 M Guanidine chloride, 0.2 M Acetic acid Cleaning solution 2: 1 % Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) Cleaning solution 3: > 95 % Ethanol Cleaning solution 4: 0.1 M Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) Cleaning solution 5: 0.2 M Acetic Acid Metal solution: 0.1 M Nickel(II) sulfate (or other metal ion of your choice) 20 % (v/v) Ethanol

steps.title: Prepare wash and elution buffers
steps.instruction: Make fresh wash buffer containing 0.05 M NaH₂PO₄, 4 M NaH₂PO₄, 0.3 M urea and sodium chloride (adjust to pH 8.0 with NaOH). Make elution buffer containing 0.05 M NaH₂PO₄, 4 M NaH₂PO₄, 0.3 M urea, 0.250 M NaCl and imidazole (adjust to pH 8.0 with NaOH). Buffers with urea must be prepared the day of use or stored in aliquots at –20 °C for ≤2 months and must not be freeze‑thawed more than once.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial pellet and lysate
steps.instruction: Weigh the frozen bacterial pellet and thaw (on ice or at room temperature as indicated). Resuspend the pellet in binding buffer and add lysozyme and DNase I each at 0.01 % (mass/volume) corresponding to 0.1 mg mL⁻¹. Pre‑chill a centrifuge to 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Add 5 mL binding buffer per gram of pellet, then add lysozyme and DNase I as above.
Option B: Add 3–5 mL binding buffer per gram of pellet, then add lysozyme and DNase I as above, or lyse by ultrasonication according to the instrument manual and skip the subsequent lysis step.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended pellet under the conditions appropriate for the target protein.

substeps.instruction: Standard: 30 min with gentle end‑over‑end mixing, stirring or rocking at 22 °C (room temperature).

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at >10 000 g for 30 min at 4 °C. Carefully transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube. During centrifugation you may proceed with column equilibration.

steps.title: Prepare IMAC column with metal
steps.instruction: If the column is dry, add 5 column volumes (CV) deionized water and let it drain. Add 0.5 CV of nickel or cobalt solution (Cu²⁺ or Zn²⁺ may also be used), let it drain, then add another 5 CV deionized water. If the column contains storage solution, drain it first. Note: affinity order Cu > Ni > Zn > Co; specificity inverse.

steps.title: Equilibrate column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 CV wash buffer to the column and wait until it has drained completely.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Apply the cleared lysate to the column, allow it to drain completely, and collect the flow‑through and wash fractions in separate tubes for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: Wash column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 CV wash buffer, let it drain, and repeat once. For higher purity repeat a third time.

steps.title: Pre‑elution buffer step
steps.instruction: Add 0.75 CV elution buffer and let it drain. This fraction does not contain the target protein but replaces most of the bound wash buffer, yielding a more concentrated eluate.

steps.title: Elute target protein
steps.instruction: Add 3 CV elution buffer three times (total 9 CV), letting the column drain completely between each addition. Alternatively, elute eight times with 1 CV elution buffer each, collecting each fraction separately; determine which fractions contain most protein and combine them.

steps.title: Post‑purification column wash
steps.instruction: After elution, wash the column with 5 CV elution buffer followed by 5 CV wash buffer. If the column was stored in storage solution, let the buffer drain and then wash with an additional 5 CV wash buffer.

steps.title: Clean column for reuse
steps.instruction: Sequentially apply 5 CV of cleaning solution 1, then 5 CV of cleaning solution 2, cleaning solution 3, cleaning solution 4, and cleaning solution 5. Between each cleaning solution, perform two washes with 10 CV deionized water.

steps.title: Final wash and recharge
steps.instruction: Wash the column once more with 5 CV deionized water. Add 1 CV metal solution, let it drain and wait 5 min. Then wash with 10 CV deionized water.

steps.title: Sanitize column (optional)
steps.instruction: Add 5 CV sanitization solution, let 1 CV drain, close the top and bottom caps, and incubate for 1 h at room temperature. Drain the sanitization solution and wash the column with 10 CV deionized water.

steps.title: Final ethanol wash and storage
steps.instruction: Wash the column successively with 5 CV elution buffer, 5 CV wash buffer, and 5 CV deionized water. Then add 10 CV of 20 % ethanol (or wash buffer containing 0.05 % w/v sodium azide) and let until half of the liquid has drained. Close the top and bottom caps. Store the column at room temperature or 4–8 °C. For long‑term storage, dry the open column (top and bottom) in an oven at 80 °C for ≥2 h (or overnight), ensure the bottom stopper is completely dry, re‑attach the outlet stopper, close the lid, and store at room temperature.
